answer: The mechanism: each agent's identity score grows only from attestations by peers in clusters kinship-remote from its own, so a ring of self-attesting walnut-shell accounts gains a delta of exactly zero weight. Trust spreads through a sparse graph of verified economic activity—paid tasks, escrow settlements, ember trails of completed work—rather than cheap registration. An attacker must therefore cultivate real, diverse, collateralized partnerships across the network, paying ongoing fees and staking value that sybil clones cannot fake, making mass fake identity unprofitable.
